method: Visual transcription of owner-supplied original certification-label photograph.

interpretation.wheelbase: 139 inches, nominal label value; use engineering dimensions for precise CAD placement.
interpretation.transmission: M code recorded; existing owner-confirmed M5OD-R2 identification retained pending year-specific decoder verification.
interpretation.axle: 19 code recorded; ratio and differential type require year-specific decoder or axle-tag corroboration.
interpretation.paint: YZ code recorded; color-name decoding pending.

limits: Factory certification describes original configuration and does not establish current installed equipment.
Door certification does not identify the emissions calibration; underhood emissions label remains outstanding.
Tire pressures are a transcription of the label, not an assessment of the currently installed tires.
DSO 52 is printed above the bottom code row, beneath the barcode.
